# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-12

This Xteink X4 release integrates the latest upstream reader improvements and updates the reading-time estimate.

## Added

- Added the optional in-reader toolbar menu and the latest EPUB navigation and text-layout improvements.
- Added the latest OPDS, keyboard-layout, Persian/RTL, power-management, and interface improvements from upstream.

## Changed

- Remaining reading time is now estimated from the time already spent reading the current book and its precise reading progress.
- The toolbar line-spacing selector uses the fork's 80–120% spacing scale.

## Fixed

- Restored the legacy 24 px file-type icons required by the fork's library interface after the upstream icon-system migration.
- Updated the pioarduino framework-cache compatibility patch for the current build platform.
- Included upstream fixes for EPUB rendering, font memory pressure, Wi-Fi downloads, deep sleep, and device wake handling.

## Notes

- Reading-speed statistics remain based on recent valid page-reading samples.
- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 only.
